_meta.jsRuntimeLeg: none — backend/space is Go-sole-authority with no TypeScript mirror by design (design.md Decision 1); this table is asserted only across the Go build-target matrix
_meta.serialization: every recorded output value is strconv.FormatFloat(v, 'b', -1, 64); inputs are plain JSON numbers

measured.note: measured over solveBurnSweep's own drawn cases (openspec add-space-kinematics tasks.md 3.4-3.6). A later loosening of any of these fails this family rather than passing silently.

realisticTraffic.note: the traffic play would actually generate, as a counterweight to the randomized sweep's adversarial box: every ordered pair of the fixture system's targetable bodies, departing from the source body's own insertion standoff, at the star's real clearance radius. Enumerable and pinned, so it records no PRNG.
realisticTraffic.departureLadder: 40 departures at 4000 ms intervals from world time 0

turnTableFile.note: the pinned two-level sub-turn table, asserted as DATA: SHA-256 of the committed file's bytes. backend/space embeds a byte-identical copy (turn_table_record_test.go asserts that), and never recomputes an entry at runtime.

turnTableSweep.note: EXHAUSTIVE, not randomized: CosSin's domain is every sub-turn index, and 2^20 of them is enumerable — recorded in the stronger form rather than sampled down.

turnTableSweep.serialization: strconv.FormatFloat(v, 'b', -1, 64), components joined by ','; an error outcome is the fixed token !err
